name: product-example
title: Product example
description: The site's product example: the specs (endpoint, MCP tool, rate limit), the request as the code block in tabs beside the response panel from 1024 (the request staying in view as the page scrolls), the JSON scrolling across and fading at its edge, and optionally the creatives it returned, three across with a line each.
use_for: Showing one real request and what comes back on a product or docs page.
never: A response the API does not return
Keys or secrets in the code: use an environment variable
source: Site pages/Products/Example (Products.module.css .specs, .example, .response, .responseHead, .responseBody, .media): specs 8px by 24px apart, t-label over mono values; the code tabs and the response 16px apart, two columns from 1024 with the request sticky at the header plus 32px; the response on --surface with --radius-m, a --control-l head 16px in (24 from 768) over a --line-surface hairline, the status in mono --text-3, the body 16px in (24 from 768) fading over 48px; returned creatives 3:4, three across 16px apart, small --text-2 lines
body:
`tabs` are the code block's tabs ({ id, label, code, language }); `media.items` are creative cards (`src`, or Acme
`brand`, `tone` and `caption`) with a `meta` line under each.

examples.content:
<!-- A media search request in three tabs beside its response and the creatives it returned (Acme). -->
<spyglass-product-example prefix="media-search" question="Find running shoe ads that ran for more than 30 days." tabs='[{"id": "mcp", "label": "MCP", "language": "bash", "code": "# Ask your agent\nFind running shoe ads that ran for more than 30 days.\n\n# It calls searchMedia\nsearchMedia({\n  \"query\": \"running shoe ads\",\n  \"minDaysLive\": 30,\n  \"limit\": 3\n})"}, {"id": "rest", "label": "REST", "language": "bash", "code": "curl -X POST https://api.acme.com/v1/media \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ACME_API_KEY\" \\\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n  -d '{\n    \"query\": \"running shoe ads\",\n    \"minDaysLive\": 30,\n    \"limit\": 3\n  }'"}, {"id": "python", "label": "Python", "language": "python", "code": "import os\nfrom acme import Acme\n\nclient = Acme(token=os.environ[\"ACME_API_KEY\"])\n\nresult = client.search_media(\n    query=\"running shoe ads\",\n    min_days_live=30,\n    limit=3,\n)"}]' response='{
  "count": 3,
  "media": [
    {
      "id": "1001",
      "brand": "Acme Run",
      "platform": "Instagram",
      "daysLive": 74
    },
    {
      "id": "1002",
      "brand": "Acme Trail",
      "platform": "TikTok",
      "daysLive": 61
    },
    {
      "id": "1003",
      "brand": "Acme Fit",
      "platform": "Meta",
      "daysLive": 48
    }
  ]
}' specs='[{"label": "Endpoint", "value": "POST /media"}, {"label": "MCP tool", "value": "searchMedia"}, {"label": "Rate limit", "value": "120 requests a minute"}]' media='{"label": "Returned creatives", "items": [{"brand": "Acme Run", "tone": 3, "caption": "Built for miles.", "meta": "Acme Run, 74 days live"}, {"brand": "Acme Trail", "tone": 2, "caption": "Off the road.", "meta": "Acme Trail, 61 days live"}, {"brand": "Acme Fit", "tone": 4, "caption": "First 5K.", "meta": "Acme Fit, 48 days live"}]}'></spyglass-product-example>
